must_haves: security and where data is stored (Stockholm)

layout.idea: Product catalogue with plates: each plan shown as a printed catalogue plate with a large number, name, and what it includes, then a single shared CTA.
layout.why: Pricing by inbox is simple; a plate per plan makes it scannable.

hero.idea: The provider list is the headline: 'Gmail. Outlook. iCloud. Fastmail. Yahoo. Zoho. Any IMAP.' set very large, each word linking to its connect guide.
hero.why: Answers 'does it work with mine?' before anything else.

visual_style.idea: Ink band: a light page with one full-width brand-ink (navy) band for the security section, cobalt and mint accents inside it, light again after.
visual_style.why: A dark accent inside a light page marks the 'vault' part of the story.

typography.idea: Libre Caslon Text 400/700 for headings and body, Courier Prime 400 for To / From / Subject lines.
typography.why: Reads like a typed letter, ties the page to correspondence.

narrative.idea: Problem first: 'Your AI can write the email. It still can't send it.' Then the fix, then the proof.
narrative.why: Names the friction every Claude or ChatGPT user knows.

proof.idea: Revoke demo: a screenshot of the revoke control and one line on what stops working immediately.
proof.why: Shows the user can always pull the plug.

asset_use.idea: Annotated dashboard: one large dashboard screenshot with numbered pins and a legend list below it.
asset_use.why: Explains the control panel in one image.

motion.idea: Client tabs: only the underline slides between Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and VS Code.
motion.why: Minimal motion on an interactive control.

section_order.idea: Short hero > FAQ as main body (Setup, Safety, Teams, Billing) > Pricing > Start free

voice.idea: Mission voice. Sample: 'Your mail belongs in your mailbox, not in one more database.'
voice.why: Frames privacy as a principle, not a feature.

wildcard.idea: One colour only: every element in brand cobalt on white, screenshots duotoned to cobalt and paper.
wildcard.why: Forces hierarchy through size and space; strong brand recall.
